tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page canvas, nav, footer, cards on a surface-subtle band, inputs. The default ground for every page.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Alternating full-width section bands (features, closing CTA), icon tiles, code blocks, chips, the CacheDrop-way panel. Never put a card on it without a line border.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Guide-page hero band, hero status pill, small secondary buttons inside code blocks, table header rows.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, modals and the app window body: anything that sits above a band. Same as surface in light; lifted in dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: card borders, section dividers, FAQ and step separators, table rules, footer top rule. Decorative only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of secondary buttons and inputs, from DESIGN.md. Below 3:1 on surface (1.5:1 light): always pair with a visible label and the focus-ring token; never use as the only boundary of a control without text.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Sticky nav background, always with the backdrop-nav effect token.

tokens.name: glass-line
tokens.usage: Bottom border of the sticky nav and the app window title bar.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals, with backdrop-modal.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, titles, nav active link, primary text and the logo. On every surface token (17:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Long-form prose on guide pages (17px article body), chips, table cells. On surface and surface-subtle (9:1+).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body copy inside cards, FAQ answers on the homepage, step bodies. On surface and surface-raised (7.9:1 light).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Sub-headlines, ledes, eyebrows, nav links at rest, captions, breadcrumbs, metadata, footer links. On surface (5.1:1), surface-elevated (4.9:1) and surface-subtle (4.7:1); in dark 6.6:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Input placeholders and non-essential marks only, from DESIGN.md. 3.6:1 on white: fails body-text contrast in light; never for information the reader needs. Fine at 24px+.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, nav CTA, storage bar fill, selected states, checkbox accent. The only brand hue: one primary action per view. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for accent buttons (from DESIGN.md). on-accent on it is 4.3:1 in light, a brief hover state only.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon colour on an accent fill (4.7:1 light, 5.9:1 dark). Never literal white in dark.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and arrow links as text, on surface, surface-subtle and accent-soft (5.0:1+ light, 7.7:1 dark). Use this, not accent, for any text link.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rating button, selected sidebar row tint, info highlights behind accent-text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status dots only (the live/beta dot in the hero pill). Never as text on light: 2.2:1.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (Copied, Thanks, check marks) on surface and success-soft (4.6:1+).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success confirmations, behind success-ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive fills and status dots for irreversible actions. Always with a word: never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text and destructive text buttons on surface (5.4:1 light, 6.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error messages, behind danger-ink.

tokens.name: cat-dev
tokens.usage: Icon colour for the Developer caches category in the app (review rows). On cat-dev-soft (6.0:1+).

tokens.name: cat-dev-soft
tokens.usage: Icon tile behind cat-dev.

tokens.name: cat-downloads
tokens.usage: Icon colour for the Downloads to review category. On cat-downloads-soft (5.6:1+).

tokens.name: cat-downloads-soft
tokens.usage: Icon tile behind cat-downloads.

tokens.name: window-chrome
tokens.usage: Title bar of the MacWindow product mock.

tokens.name: window-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar of the MacWindow product mock.

tokens.name: window-selected
tokens.usage: Selected sidebar row in the product mock.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of StorageBar and progress tracks.

tokens.name: traffic-close
tokens.usage: Window close dot in MacWindow only.

tokens.name: traffic-minimize
tokens.usage: Window minimize dot in MacWindow only.

tokens.name: traffic-zoom
tokens.usage: Window zoom dot in MacWindow only.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Alias of accent-text for inline links in prose.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Colour of the focus ring; alias of accent.

families.sans: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Large headlines: weight 600, tight negative tracking. On the web they scale with clamp() between the mobile and desktop sizes noted in each usage.

styles.name: display-xl

styles.name: display-lg

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Closing CTA headline. Web: clamp(32px, 4.4vw, 52px).

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Utility-page H1 (download, confirmation). Web: clamp(34px, 4.6vw, 56px).

styles.name: headline-lg
styles.usage: Homepage section H2. Web: clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 40px).

styles.name: headline-md

styles.usage: Guide-page section H2. Web: clamp(26px, 3vw, 34px).

styles.name: headline-sm

styles.name: title-md

styles.name: title-sm

styles.name: body-xs

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: Large (48px) button labels.

styles.name: label-md
styles.usage: Medium buttons, arrow links, form labels at 13px use label-sm.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Nav links, small buttons, form field labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows above H2s and TOC titles. Always uppercase (text-transform), ink-secondary.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: The BETA tag beside the wordmark. Uppercase.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: JetBrains Mono for anything a person could type or paste: paths, commands, file extensions, step numbers.

styles.name: code-md
styles.usage: Code blocks, table path cells, step numbers (01 02 03).

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Chips on feature cards; textarea placeholder hint.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: InlineCode inside prose: scales with the surrounding text.

spacing.note: 4px base, 8px rhythm. Gaps between siblings use gap, never margins.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-7

tokens.name: space-20

tokens.name: space-22

shadow.note: Hairlines first; shadows are faint and reserved for things that float.

tokens.name: focus-ring
